title: Design: narrower than 1024 px the reports show the mobile filter row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Use a desktop browser window 900 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the filter row.
  2. Look at the table.
  3. Open A/P Unpaid Invoices at the same width and look again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The native mobile filter row shows instead of the desktop chips.

Step 2:

  • The table scrolls sideways.
  • Nothing else is laid out for small screens.

Step 3:

  • The same: the mobile filter row and a table that scrolls sideways.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • Out of Scope: “A phone or tablet layout. Narrower than 1024 pixels, the reports show the native mobile filter row and the table scrolls sideways; nothing else is designed for small screens in this release.”
  • Form factor: “Form factor: Desktop only by rule: these are detailed reports.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
